items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Eddie Miller played with a little band. I'll tell you who the band was. It was Eddie Miller, Lloyd Miller played drums, Benny Miller played banjo, and a fella by the name of Irwin Carroll played cornet... I had Eddie playing on the Strand Theater one day when he was just about, I guess twelve years

ctx.x: And Billy Huntington was another pupil of his.

Billy Huntington, yeah, Billy. Well, uh. Bill he is. Yeah, Bill Huntington. Yeah, Bill Huntington. Well, his dad used to come around quite a bit. His dad played violin, see. His dad used to come around with Bill. Bill was just, you know, young. In fact, a lot of like, what you call him now, Dr. John. When he was little, his dad used to bring him around. Yeah. But getting back to Johnny Petusi's band, I wanted to tell you this too. Eddie Miller's dad, you know, Eddie Miller's dad and I were very, very good friends…
Go ahead. No, you're good. Tell me. I was just wondering about Eddie Miller's instrument then. What did he play when you first knew him?
